note: ShatterBlock's in-game radio manifest. Deliberately game-local (NOT the shared cross-game network) so the dial only carries Polkahole + ShatterBlock's own originals — no other game's tracks. Polkahole loops Rafters Ring + High Ridge Revelry on repeat. The 4 ShatterBlock originals were re-synthesized 2026-11-14 with richer synths + live feel.
